summary: Returns the value as a slide, or throws.
description: An Apps Script service object has no constructor a script can test against, so the guard looks for the methods that define the type — `getObjectId`, `getPageElementById`. A stub that implements them passes, which is what makes code using this guard testable outside the runtime.
`isX` and `nonX` answer a question and never interrupt control flow; `requireX` and `requireNonX` hand the value back or throw. The scheme is explained in [](validation-conventions.md).

params.message: The message of the exception. A default is used when omitted.
params.strict: When `true`, a string counts as empty only if it has no characters at all; by default whitespace is trimmed first.

returns: the same value, typed as a slide.

throws.SlideNotFoundException: the value is not a slide.

examples.title: What passes and what does not
examples.body:
```javascript
const slide = SlidesApp.getActivePresentation().getSlides()[0];

requireSlide(slide); // => slide
requireSlide({}); // throws SlideNotFoundException
requireSlide(null); // throws SlideNotFoundException
```
